errors.evidence: This statement is a false conclusion based on the previous color mapping error. It claims zero results for the "Силно несъгласен" (Strongly disagree) category because there are no green bars. However, there are several dark blue bars for this category with non-zero values (e.g., 21% for women 19-25, 13% for men 35-44).
For women in the 19-25 age group, the chart shows that 16% are in the "Не мога да преценя" (Can't judge) category, not 21% as stated.

For women in the 19-25 age group, the chart shows that 21% are in the "Силно несъгласни" (Strongly disagree) category, not 16% as stated. The description appears to have swapped the values for this category and the "Не мога да преценя" category.
